sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य कृतार्था रघुनन्दन ।प्रणिपत्य सुराः सर्वे पितामहम् अपूजयन् ॥१-३७-९॥
transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya kṛtārthā raghunandana ।praṇipatya surāḥ sarve pitāmaham apūjayan ॥1-37-9॥

translations.english: "O son of the Raghus having heard Brahma's words all the devatas considered themselves successful in their mission. They saluted him with folded hands and offered their worship.
